describes: packages/plugin/search: the session, degradation and errors, hit geometry, the permission twin, navigation and the rerun effect.

cases.name: initial-reads
cases.covers: Before any search every read answers the idle state: null query, no hits, -1 active, zero progress, no error; next/prev/goTo with no hits return null and dispatch nothing.

cases.name: streams-a-cursor-chain
cases.covers: search() dispatches START, requests full mode with no start page (no Stage), APPENDs each slice with cumulative progress, threads the cursor, and COMPLETEs on a null cursor; the first hit becomes active and hitsByPage indexes by pon.

cases.name: deferred-slices-stream-in
cases.covers: With each slice deferred, state is usable between them: status stays searching, an empty slice only advances progress, and the next request goes out only after the previous slice lands.

cases.name: a-new-search-supersedes
cases.covers: A second search() aborts the running slice with reason "superseded" and restarts from START; the old loop stops silently, and a late answer to the aborted slice changes nothing.

cases.name: superseding-between-slices
cases.covers: Superseding after a slice has landed aborts the in-flight follow-up; aborting a settled slice is a no-op, and the stale loop never dispatches again.

cases.name: a-completed-session-is-not-aborted
cases.covers: Searching again after completion aborts nothing: the finished loop cleared its in-flight handle.

cases.name: clear-aborts-and-resets
cases.covers: clear() aborts the in-flight slice with reason "cleared", dispatches CLEAR and resolves the run cancelled; a late answer is ignored; clear() when idle dispatches nothing.

cases.name: empty-text-is-clear
cases.covers: search() with an empty text makes no engine call: it is clear(), aborting a running session with "cleared".

cases.name: query-flags-reach-the-engine
cases.covers: The stored query is the caller's SearchQuery verbatim, every flag included, and the request carries it unchanged.

cases.name: exec-start-page
cases.covers: exec.startPage seeds the first request; the cursor then owns position and startPage is not sent again.

cases.name: snippets-denied-degrade-to-rects
cases.covers: A PermissionDenied on the first full request degrades to rects and retries from the same origin with no second START; the rest of the chain stays in rects.

cases.name: forbidden-degrades-too
cases.covers: The cloud refusal, EngineError Forbidden, degrades the same way.

cases.name: denied-in-rects-is-an-error
cases.covers: Refused again in rects mode, the session enters error with the refusal's message.

cases.name: denied-mid-chain-is-an-error
cases.covers: A refusal on a cursor request does not degrade: position would be lost, so the session errors.

cases.name: stale-cursor-restarts-once
cases.covers: An InvalidArg on a cursor request restarts from scratch once, with a fresh START (hits reset) and the original origin; the restarted chain completes.

cases.name: a-second-stale-cursor-is-an-error
cases.covers: The restart happens once: a second InvalidArg on a cursor errors the session.

cases.name: invalid-query-is-an-error
cases.covers: An InvalidArg with no cursor (a bad regex, a regex with matchDiacritics) is not a stale cursor: the session errors at once.

cases.name: engine-error-after-hits
cases.covers: A later slice failing keeps the hits already streamed and records the error message; a new search clears it.

cases.name: non-engine-errors-report-their-message
cases.covers: Any Error the engine rejects with reaches ERROR as its message.

cases.name: a-user-unit-of-zero-still-converts
cases.covers: Hits convert through the page space, which reads only the crop: a page with userUnit 0 converts like any other and the session completes.

cases.name: rerun
cases.covers: rerun() while idle does nothing; after completion, or after an error, it replays the stored query from scratch.

cases.name: close-mid-search
cases.covers: Closing the document aborts the guarded slice: the run resolves cancelled, and a slice answered after close is dropped.

cases.name: hit-geometry
cases.covers: Engine quads map from PDF space to content space through the page's crop (rotation and userUnit do not enter at zoom 1), rect is recomputed from the mapped quad, bounds is the union of segments, advance and snippet ride along; a match with no segments has no bounds, a null snippet is dropped, and a match on an unknown page is dropped (cached per slice).

cases.name: can-search
cases.covers: canSearch() and canSearch({snippets:false}) ask doc.text.search; canSearch({snippets:true}) also needs doc.text.copy; copy alone finds nothing; the wildcard grants both.
cases.reason: Pins permission reads, page reads and the order close races settle in, through call outcomes and settlements. Its committed stateChanges are compared; full snapshots are omitted.

cases.name: verbs-carry-no-gate
cases.covers: With search denied the verbs still ask the engine (the engine enforces; the error state reports).

cases.name: navigation-wraps
cases.covers: next/prev/goTo dispatch SET_ACTIVE with the index wrapped modulo the hit count (negative, more than twice the count below zero, and past the end alike) and return the hit; with no Stage nothing moves.

cases.name: navigation-before-the-first-slice
cases.covers: While the first slice is in flight there are no hits: navigation returns null and dispatches nothing.

cases.name: mutation-events-rerun-debounced
cases.covers: A document event while idle arms nothing; with a search stored, every event restarts a 250 ms timer, and one rerun fires after the burst goes quiet.

cases.name: rerun-after-clear-is-disarmed
cases.covers: A timer armed while searching still fires after clear(); rerun() then finds the session idle and does nothing.

cases.name: rerun-supersedes-a-running-scan
cases.covers: A rerun during a scan aborts the in-flight slice as superseded and restarts.

cases.name: close-disarms-the-timer
cases.covers: Closing the document clears an armed timer and unsubscribes from the event stream.

cases.name: close-with-no-timer
cases.covers: Closing with nothing armed only unsubscribes.
cases.reason: Pins permission reads, page reads and the order close races settle in, through call outcomes and settlements. Its committed stateChanges are compared; full snapshots are omitted.

cases.name: search-signal-already-aborted
cases.covers: A search whose signal is already aborted never starts: the lane rejects it 'cancelled before start', so it resolves cancelled and onCancelled reports an empty operation id, but the session is not its to cancel and no CANCELLED is dispatched over the finished run.

cases.name: cancel-keeps-the-hits
cases.covers: cancel() aborts the in-flight slice with reason "cancelled"; the run resolves cancelled with the hits found so far, the session dispatches CANCELLED and keeps them, and onCancelled reports the reason; cancel() with nothing running does nothing.

cases.name: session-events
cases.covers: A run emits onStarted, one onProgress per slice with the running hit count, and onCompleted; navigation emits onActiveHitChanged only when the index moves; a superseded run reports onCancelled superseded, a clear during a run cancelled with reason cleared and then onCleared, a clear while idle nothing, and a failure onFailed with its PluginErrorInfo; an unsubscribed listener hears nothing more.

cases.name: page-reads
cases.covers: getHitCount with a page counts that page's bucket (0 for a page with none); listPagesWithHits names each page with hits once, in object-number order, and is empty before any hit.
cases.reason: Pins permission reads, page reads and the order close races settle in, through call outcomes and settlements. Its committed stateChanges are compared; full snapshots are omitted.

cases.name: a-failed-rerun-is-swallowed
cases.covers: A mutation rerun whose scan fails records the error through the session; the timer swallows the rejected refresh.

cases.name: close-races-the-session-and-find-all
cases.covers: Closing with a session scan and a findAll both in flight settles both promises in one step: the order they settle in is fixed by how many turns each chain takes from the guarded rejection (the session resolves cancelled through the lane and its catch; findAll rejects instance-closed through collect alone).

cases.name: close-races-find-all-first
cases.covers: The same race with findAll started first: settlement order does not follow call order.
